note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 5.1.4 ("If a BGP speaker is configured to alter the value of the MULTI_EXIT_DISC attribute received over EBGP, then altering the value MUST be done prior to determining the degree of preference of the route and prior to performing route selection (Decision Process phases 1 and 2)."). The single-polarity annotation is accurate: the requirement constrains only execution ordering of an optional local alteration before Decision Process phases 1 and 2. TestRFC4271ReceivedMEDAlteredBeforeTheDecisionProcess (policy chain) and TestRFC4271MEDAlterationHappensAtIngress (in-process ingress step) drive Reactor.notifyMessageReceiver with MED 100 altered to MED 10 and assert both RawBytes and WireUpdate.Payload() dispatched to the RIB plugin carry MED 10.
